name: – Ilhan Kyuchyuk – Recital N – Am 5
title: REPORT containing a motion for a non-legislative resolution on the draft Council decision on the conclusion, on behalf of the Union, of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Republic of Uzbekistan, of the other part
part_text: N. whereas Uzbekistan is the EU’s second-largest trading partner in Central Asia, with the total value of trade between Uzbekistan and the EU at almost EUR 4.8 billion in 2024; whereas the EU is Uzbekistan’s third-largest trading partner: in 2024, 10.4 % of trade was with the EU and 7.2 % of exports went to the EU; whereas the EU Member States need to tap into this economic potential in order to increase the opportunities for European companies to access Uzbekistan’s market of 38.2 million consumers;
